editorial:
Imagine getting pulled into a murder case where nothing is as it seems. You follow Alex, a sharp detective who has to team up with Josef and a suspended cop named Vilhelm to solve a brutal crime. The whole mood is cold and tense, making you feel like you are right there in the rainy streets. Things get weird when the victim is linked to a digital university called Howl, which studies how men fit into today's world. To make matters more interesting, an old case involving the Balcony Man resurfaces, which forces the legendary Martin Beck to step back into the office. It feels like a giant puzzle where every piece is a bit rusty, but they all fit together in a way that keeps you guessing.

The acting is top-notch and makes the characters feel like real people you know. The pacing is steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you want non-stop action. However, the twists are worth the wait. If you enjoy gritty mysteries, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality, or if you prefer renting, Apple TV is a great bet. For those who love owning their movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The mystery wraps up when the team discovers the killer was using the digital university to hide their tracks. In the final scenes, the connection between the new murder and the old Balcony Man case is revealed, proving the killer was obsessed with a specific social message. Martin Beck uses his old-school detective skills to trap the culprit in a tense standoff. The movie ends with the team finally finding peace, though the dark themes leave you thinking about the world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty Nordic noir and complex police procedurals.
